failureClassification.evidence: All nine failures are extra analyticsTransactionId fields; two also show optional newCoins undefined and one optional newlyUnlockedAchievementIds undefined. Production checkout intentionally returns these fields. No coin amount/order mismatch was reported, but later assertions in these tests are not established because their first equality assertion fails.

The test invokes the hook outside a React renderer and mocks useContext/useEffect/useRef/useState only. Runtime hook now calls useMemo and useLayoutEffect; real useMemo has no dispatcher and fails before polling/cancellation assertions execute. This does not demonstrate invalid hook use in production components.
